DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知を二通お持ちですね。どちらもご本人宛てのものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two notices. Are they both addressed to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一通は私、もう一通は同居している兄宛てです。一緒に住んでいるので、私だけで予約すれば二人分の手続きも済むと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分と同居の兄への通知を示し、自分だけの予約で二人分の手続きも済むと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: One is for me and the other for my older brother who lives with me. Since we live together, I thought making a reservation just for me would let us complete both our procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the notices for yourself and your older brother who lives with you, and explain that you thought your reservation alone would cover both procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名が異なる場合、内容の確認やお手続きの条件も同じとは限りません。お兄様は、今回は同席されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: When the addressees differ, the conditions for checking contents and completing procedures are not necessarily the same. Will your older brother attend this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 兄は今日は仕事で来られません。相談してきてほしいとは頼まれましたが、代理の書類は預かっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄は仕事で不在で相談を頼まれたが、代理の書類は預かっていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: He is working today and cannot come. He asked me to seek advice, but I have not been given any authorization documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your older brother is absent because of work and asked you to consult, but you have no authorization documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の通知についての相談と、お兄様の個別の情報を扱うことは分けて確認します。まず、どの部分を知りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will distinguish consultation about your own notice from handling your brother's personal information. First, which parts would you like to know about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の通知の期限と、予約が必要な窓口を知りたいです。兄の通知は私が見せるだけで手続きを頼めるとは考えず、相談方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の期限と予約窓口を知りたく、兄の通知を見せるだけで手続きできると決めず相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to know the deadline on my notice and which counter needs a reservation. I will not assume that merely showing my brother's notice lets me request his procedure; please tell me how to consult about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about your deadline and reservation counter, and how to consult about your brother's notice without assuming showing it alone permits his procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの担当と、同席や代理相談に必要な条件を照会します。予約の調整で、言葉の支援や日時のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask each department about conditions for attending together or consulting on someone's behalf. Do you need language support or have preferred dates and times for reservations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私にはベトナム語の支援があると助かります。兄と二人で来られる日も探しますが、一度の予約でよいかは担当へ確認してから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベトナム語支援を希望し兄と来られる日を探すが、一件の予約でよいか担当確認後に決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Vietnamese support would help me. I will look for a day when my brother and I can come together, but want to decide whether one reservation is enough only after checking with the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request Vietnamese support and say you will look for a day to attend with your brother, but decide whether one reservation suffices after staff confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 言語支援の利用可否も含めて確認します。二人同時に相談できると決まるまでは、お兄様の予定を確定させずにお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also check whether language support is available. Please do not finalize your brother's schedule until it is confirmed that you can consult together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 兄には、同席の条件と予約の取り方を確認中だと伝えます。まず自分の通知の相談を進め、二人分の手続きが予約だけで済むとは約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 兄へ同席と予約条件は確認中と伝え、自分の相談を先に進め二人分の完了を約束しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my brother we are checking the conditions for attending together and making reservations. I will proceed with my own consultation first and will not promise that a reservation alone completes both our procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your brother attendance and reservation conditions are being checked, proceed with your own consultation first, and not promise completion of both procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人宛ての通知から拝見します。お兄様の分は相談条件の照会として分け、確認できた順にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us look at the notice addressed to you first. We will handle your brother's separately as an inquiry about consultation conditions and guide you as answers become available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計後の書類を見ておられますが、何かお気づきの点がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the documents after payment. Did you notice something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場に出す領収書に、前の名字が載っています。今日受診した分ですが、このまま提出してよいのか困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日の受診の領収書が旧姓で、職場へそのまま提出してよいか困っていると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The receipt I need to submit at work shows my previous surname. It is for today's visit, and I do not know whether I can submit it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the receipt for today's visit has your former surname and you are unsure whether to submit it unchanged at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職場が受け付けるかどうかは、こちらでは判断できません。受付時には、名字が変わったことをお伝えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot decide whether your workplace will accept it. Did you tell reception that your surname changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察券を出しただけで、変更を伝えていませんでした。職場では今の名字を使っているので、書類の名前も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付では診察券だけを出し改姓を伝えておらず、職場の現姓と書類の名前を確認したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only handed over my patient card and did not mention the change. I use my current surname at work, so I want to check the name on the documents too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only presented your patient card without reporting the surname change, and want to check the document name against your current workplace surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録情報と書類の扱いを担当へ確認する必要があります。私がここで書き換えることはできませんが、取り次いでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to ask the staff about registered information and document handling. I cannot rewrite it here, but may I refer you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で旧姓を線で消して書き直す前に、正式に訂正を相談できる窓口と、必要な確認書類を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で線を引いて直す前に、正式な訂正の相談先と必要な確認書類を教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before crossing out my former surname and rewriting it myself, I want to know the counter for requesting an official correction and the required verification documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Before correcting it yourself with a line through the name, ask where to consult about official correction and what verification documents are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付と会計の担当へ確認します。職場への提出期限が迫っているなど、お伝えしておくご事情はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with reception and billing staff. Is there anything they should know, such as an approaching workplace deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 提出は明日と言われています。ただ、今日中に直せると決まったわけではないので、職場には病院へ確認中だと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出期限は明日だが今日訂正できるとは決めず、職場へ確認中と連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They told me to submit it tomorrow. But correction today is not guaranteed, so I will tell work I am checking with the hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the deadline is tomorrow but you will not assume correction is possible today, and will tell work the hospital is checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご事情も申し送ります。領収書のほかに、同じ名字が載った書類はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on too. Besides the receipt, do you have other documents showing the same surname?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一緒にもらった明細書も旧姓でした。二枚ともそのまま保管して担当へ見せます。訂正の可否と受け取れる時期を確認してから、職場に返事をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 明細書も旧姓だと伝え二枚とも保管して示し、訂正可否と受取時期を確認後に職場へ返事すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The itemized statement I received with it also has my former surname. I will keep both unchanged and show the staff. After checking whether correction is possible and when I can receive them, I will reply to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the statement also has your former surname, keep and show both unchanged, and reply to work after checking correction and collection timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二枚をお手元に置いてお待ちください。担当へおつなぎしますので、登録の確認と書類の相談を続けていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep both documents with you and wait. I will connect you to the staff so you can continue checking your registration and discussing the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘の件でお越しですね。いまお手元に傘はありますか、それとも見つからない状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You came about an umbrella. Do you currently have an umbrella, or is yours still missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の傘は見つかりません。店から似た傘を持ち出してしまいましたが、違うと気づいて、その傘は店の人に返しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た傘を持ち出して違いに気づき店員へ返したが、自分の傘は不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find mine. I took a similar umbrella out of a shop, realized it was different, and returned that umbrella to the shop staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you took a similar umbrella, noticed the mistake and returned it to shop staff, but your own is still missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取り違えに気づいた理由と、ご自分の傘の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what made you realize the mistake and the features of your umbrella.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ紺色でしたが、持ち手の修理跡がありませんでした。私の傘には、持ち手に細い白いテープが巻いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持ち手の修理跡がないため取り違えと気づき、自分の紺色の傘には白い細いテープがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was the same navy blue, but had no repair mark on the handle. Mine has thin white tape wrapped around the handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you noticed the mistake because the handle lacked a repair mark, and your navy umbrella has thin white tape on its handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自分の傘を最後に確かめたのは、そのお店でしょうか。置いた場所も覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Was that shop the last place you confirmed your own umbrella? Do you remember where you left it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店に入るとき、入口の傘立てに置きました。出るときは急いでいて、修理跡を見ずに似た傘を取ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入店時に入口の傘立てへ置き、退出時は急いで修理跡を見ずに似た傘を取ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: When entering the shop I put it in the umbrella stand at the entrance. I was rushing when leaving and took a similar umbrella without checking the repair mark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you put it in the entrance stand and, rushing when leaving, took a similar umbrella without checking its repair mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お店には、ご自分の傘が残っていないかも確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you also ask the shop whether your own umbrella remained there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店員さんが見てくれましたが、その時には見つかりませんでした。誰かが間違えて持ったのかは分からないので、盗まれたとは決めずに相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店員が探した時にはなく、他人の取り違えも不明なので盗難と決めず相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The staff looked, but could not find it then. I do not know whether someone took it by mistake, so I want advice without deciding it was stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say staff could not find it then and another person's mix-up is also unknown, so you do not want to assume theft. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 経緯と特徴を整理して、届いている物の照会や届出の相談を進めます。後でお店から連絡があった場合にも、分かるようにしておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will organize the circumstances and features, then discuss checking handed-in items or filing a report. Let us also arrange to identify your case if the shop contacts you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 店から連絡が来たら、こちらへも知らせます。白いテープの特徴と取り違えた経緯を記録して、届出後の連絡方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店から連絡が来れば警察へも知らせると述べ、白テープと取り違えの記録、届出後の連絡方法を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: If the shop contacts me, I will tell you too. Please record the white tape and the mix-up, and tell me how to make contact after filing the report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will also notify the police if the shop contacts you, and request a record of the white tape and mix-up plus contact instructions after reporting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、連絡先と経緯を用紙で確認します。お店へ返した傘と、ご自分の傘の情報を分けて、こちらでご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us confirm your contact details and the circumstances on the form. Please write the information about the umbrella returned to the shop separately from your own umbrella.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お受け取りの前に、不在票の宛名を一緒に確認してもよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before collection, may we check the addressee on the missed-delivery slip together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通販の荷物だと思って持ってきましたが、よく見ると名前が違います。住所は自宅のようですが、私や家族の名前ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通販と思った不在票の住所は自宅らしいが、宛名は自分でも家族でもないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought it thinking it was an online order, but on closer inspection the name differs. The address seems to be home, but the name is neither mine nor my family's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the missed-delivery slip you thought was your online order seems to have your address but neither your nor your family's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その宛名に心当たりはありますか。お引っ越しなどで、以前の居住者の郵便物が届いたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you recognize that name? Have you received mail for a previous resident after moving, for example?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引っ越してきたばかりなので、以前住んでいた人かどうかも分かりません。住所が同じなら自分で受け取れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転居直後で以前の居住者かも不明だが、同住所なら受け取れると思っていたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I just moved in, so I do not know if it is a previous resident. I thought I could collect it if the address was the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you recently moved in and do not know if it is a previous resident, but thought the same address allowed collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住所が同じというだけで、お渡しできるとは限りません。この票に記載された荷物と、ご自身の注文は分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The same address alone does not necessarily allow us to hand it over. Let us check the parcel on this slip separately from your own order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 注文履歴には自分の名前が載っています。そこにある番号と、不在票の番号を見比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注文履歴には自分の名前があり、そこの番号と不在票を比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: My order history shows my name. I want to compare the number there with the missed-delivery slip number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your order history has your name and you want to compare its number with the missed-delivery slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号が一致するか確認しましょう。一致しない場合には、別の荷物の可能性もあるので、ご注文の配送状況は注文先にもお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check whether the numbers match. If not, it could be another parcel, so please also ask the seller about your order's delivery status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は違いました。自分の注文は注文先へ聞きます。この不在票は、宛名に心当たりがないものとして、どう扱えばよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号が違うため自分の注文は注文先へ聞き、不明な宛名の不在票の扱いを教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The numbers are different. I will ask the seller about my order. Please tell me how to handle this slip as one addressed to someone I do not recognize.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the numbers differ, you will ask the seller about your order, and request guidance on a slip with an unfamiliar addressee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで票の内容を確認し、担当へ取り次ぎます。他の方の荷物について、中身や詳しい情報はお伝えできませんが、その点はよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the slip and refer it to the responsible staff. We cannot disclose the contents or details of another person's parcel. Is that understood?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 中身を知る必要はありません。自分の荷物として持ち帰ったり再配達を頼んだりせず、宛名に心当たりのない票として相談をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 中身の情報は不要と述べ、自分の荷物として受領や再配達を申し込まず不明宛名の票として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I do not need to know the contents. I will not take it home as mine or request redelivery; please treat this as a consultation about a slip with an unfamiliar name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you do not need the contents disclosed and will not collect or request redelivery as your parcel, but want advice about the unfamiliar addressee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。票を拝見して担当に確認しますので、受取手続きは進めず、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will inspect the slip and check with the staff. Please wait here without proceeding with collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードがお手元にないとのことですが、最後に使った後の様子を覚えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You do not have your card. Do you remember what happened after you last used it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 現金自動預払機でお金を下ろした後、カードが見つかりません。財布に戻したか、機械から出なかったのかも思い出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引出後にカードがなく、財布へ戻したか機械から出なかったかも思い出せないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find it after withdrawing money at an ATM. I cannot remember whether I returned it to my wallet or whether it never came out of the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your card is missing after a withdrawal and you do not recall returning it to your wallet or whether it failed to come out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 機械を使った場所と、おおよその時刻が分かる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have something showing where you used the machine and the approximate time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の店の中にある機械で、今日の昼です。利用した控えがあり、機械の名前と時刻も載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の店内の機械を今日の昼に使い、機械名と時刻の載った控えがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was a machine inside another shop, at midday today. I have the transaction receipt, showing the machine name and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you used a machine inside another shop at midday today and have a receipt showing the machine name and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その控えは照会の手掛かりになります。カードを発行した銀行は当行でしょうか、それとも別の銀行でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That receipt will help the inquiry. Was the card issued by our bank or another bank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードは別の銀行のものです。機械を使った場所に近いこちらへ来ましたが、カードの発行元とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カードは別銀行の発行で、機械利用場所に近いだけの相談先へ来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is another bank's card. I came here because you are near where I used the machine, but you are not its issuer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that another bank issued the card and you came here only because it is near the machine you used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機械の管理先とカード発行元では、確認できる内容が異なります。紛失時の利用停止などは発行元へご相談いただく必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The machine operator and card issuer can check different information. You need to consult the issuer about blocking use after a loss and similar matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードの対応は発行元に連絡します。機械の中に残っていると決めずに、控えを基に機械の管理先を調べる方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行元へ連絡すると述べ、機械内と断定せず控えから管理先を調べる方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact the issuer about the card. Without assuming it remains inside the machine, please also tell me how to identify the machine operator from the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the issuer, and ask how to find the operator from the receipt without assuming the card is inside the machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えにある連絡先の案内を確認しましょう。なお、機械内にあるかどうかや、返却できるかは、こちらでは確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the contact guidance on the receipt. We cannot determine here whether the card is inside the machine or can be returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日ここで返してもらえるとは考えず、発行元へ停止などの相談をします。管理先にも時刻と場所を伝え、カードの状態を別々に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 即日返却と決めず発行元へ停止などを相談し、管理先には時刻と場所を伝えて別々に照会すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume I can get it back here today; I will ask the issuer about blocking it and other steps. I will separately tell the operator the time and place and ask about the card's status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not expect same-day return, will consult the issuer about blocking, and separately give the operator the time and place to inquire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、控えの機械情報と問い合わせ案内を一緒に確認します。停止済みとはまだ確認できていませんので、発行元への連絡も進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check the machine information and inquiry instructions on the receipt together. The card is not yet confirmed blocked, so please also proceed with contacting the issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの弁当箱について、ふたの閉まり方を確認したいというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to check how the lid of your lunch box closes, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った弁当箱のふたが閉まりません。ここが浮いてしまうので、不具合なのか見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日買った弁当箱のふたが浮いて閉まらず、不具合か見てほしいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lunch box I bought yesterday will not close. This part sticks up, so I want you to check whether it is faulty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the lid of yesterday's lunch box sticks up and will not close, and ask whether it is defective. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入が分かる物と、箱やふたの表示はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have proof of purchase and the markings on the box and lid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: レシートと本体、ふたを持ってきました。外の包装は家にありますが、このふたが一緒に入っていた物か少し自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシート・本体・ふたを示し、包装は家で、元からのふたか確信がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the receipt, main box, and lid. The outer packaging is at home, but I am not completely sure this lid originally came with the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt, box, and lid, and explain that the packaging is at home and you are unsure the lid is the original one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自宅に、よく似た別の弁当箱もありますか。まず、本体とふたの型や大きさを見比べてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have another similar lunch box at home? First let us compare the models and sizes of the box and lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族が色違いの物を使っています。大きさも同じだと思っていましたが、洗った後にふたを一緒に置いたので、取り違えたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族の色違い品も同じ大きさと思い、洗った後にふたを一緒に置いて取り違えた可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family uses one in a different color. I thought it was the same size too, but I put the lids together after washing them, so I may have mixed them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought your family's different-colored box was the same size and may have mixed up the lids after putting them together when washed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの表示では、持参された本体とふたの大きさが一致していないようです。包装や、もう一つのふたを確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: According to these markings, the sizes of the box and lid you brought seem not to match. Can you check the packaging and the other lid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家に帰って包装と家族のふたを確かめます。今回の商品が壊れていると決めず、元の組み合わせを確認してから相談し直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で包装と家族のふたを確認し、破損と決めず元の組み合わせを確かめて再相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the packaging and my family's lid when I get home. I will not assume this product is broken; I want to confirm the original combination and then consult again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the packaging and family's lid at home, establish the original pairing without assuming breakage, and consult again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その際は、分かった表示もお知らせください。正しい組み合わせでも閉まらない場合は、状態に応じて対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us the markings you find then. If it still will not close with the correct combination, we will check the response based on its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 正しい組み合わせでどうなるかを伝え、交換を頼めるか改めて尋ねます。今日は本体とふた、レシートを持ち帰って保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい組合せでの状態を伝えて交換可否を再相談し、今日は三点を持ち帰り保管すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain what happens with the correct combination and ask again whether I can request an exchange. Today I will take the box, lid, and receipt home and keep them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report the condition with the correct pairing and ask about exchange again, and take all three items home to keep today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お持ちの三点をお返しします。無理に押して閉めず、組み合わせが確認できた後に、必要ならもう一度お声をおかけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your three items back. Do not force it shut. After confirming the pairing, please ask us again if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの時間に合わせて散歩を考えていらっしゃるのですね。使う予定の道は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are planning a walk to fit your departure time. Have you chosen your route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰りのバスに間に合うよう、この紙の図にある橋を渡って戻るつもりです。近道なら、奥の広場まで歩けると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰りのバスに間に合うよう紙の図の橋を近道に使い、奥の広場まで歩くつもりだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intend to return across the bridge on this paper map to catch my bus. I thought that shortcut would let me walk as far as the inner plaza.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to reach the inner plaza and use the paper map's bridge as a shortcut back in time for your bus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その橋は、今日の掲示では通行止めになっています。紙の図は、いつ手に入れたものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today's notice says that bridge is closed. When did you get this paper map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前に来た家族からもらった図です。今日の掲示は見ていませんでした。橋を使えないなら、戻る道が長くなりそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族から以前の図をもらい当日の掲示は見ておらず、橋なしでは帰路が長くなると思うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: A family member who visited before gave it to me. I had not looked at today's notice. Without the bridge, the way back seems likely to be longer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you received an old map from family, have not checked today's notice, and think the return route will be longer without the bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の通行案内で迂回する道を確認する必要があります。バス停までの移動も含め、どのくらい時間を見込んでいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the detour using the current route information. How much time have you allowed, including reaching the bus stop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 公園を出てからバス停へ行く時間を計算に入れていませんでした。奥の広場へ行くのはやめて、近い所で休める道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出口からバス停までの時間を入れていなかったと伝え、奥の広場をやめ近くの休憩できる道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not include the time from leaving the park to the bus stop. I will give up the inner plaza and would like a nearby route with somewhere to rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you omitted travel time from the exit to the bus stop, will skip the inner plaza, and ask for a nearby route where you can rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの図で、入口寄りの休憩場所の表示を確認できます。ただし、今席が空いているかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: This map shows rest areas nearer the entrance. However, I do not know whether seats are available now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座れると決めて奥まで進まず、この近くで休めるか見ます。空いていなければ散歩を切り上げて出口へ戻るつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座れると決めて奥へ進まず近くで休めるか見て、空席がなければ散歩を切り上げると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not go far in assuming I can sit; I will see whether I can rest nearby. If no seats are free, I plan to end the walk and return to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check nearby for somewhere to rest without going deeper assuming a seat, and end the walk if none is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場合も、公園から出る時刻は余裕を持ってお決めください。バスの時刻と乗り場は、別途確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even then, decide when to leave the park with plenty of time. Have you separately checked the bus departure and boarding location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: バスの時刻表をもう一度確かめて、公園を出る目安を決めます。古い図の橋は使わず、今日の掲示を見ながら近い範囲だけ歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: バス時刻表を見直して退出目安を決め、古い図の橋を使わず当日の掲示で近い範囲を歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will recheck the bus timetable and decide a target time to leave the park. I will not use the bridge on the old map, but walk only nearby while checking today's notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will recheck the timetable and set a departure target, avoid the old map's bridge, and walk nearby using today's notices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、今日通れる道と出口の位置をこの案内で照合しましょう。確認ができてから、ご予定に合わせてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us compare today's open paths and the exit location on this guide. Once checked, please set out to suit your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符をお求めですね。何名様の、どちらまでの分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like tickets. For how many people and to where?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と二人で出掛けます。友人から切符をお願いと言われたので、二人分を買いたいです。行先はこの駅です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人に頼まれたため二人分の切符を希望し、行先の駅を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going out with a friend. They asked me to get tickets, so I want to buy for two. Our destination is this station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request two tickets because your friend asked you to buy them, and show the destination station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人とも、これから買うご予定ですか。お連れの方から新しい連絡はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are both of you planning to buy them now? Has your companion sent any new messages?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい連絡が来ていました。「買えた」とあります。私の分も含めてなのかは、この短い文だけでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の新しい買えたという連絡に気づくが、自分の分も含むかは不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There was a new message. It says 'I bought it.' From this short message I cannot tell whether that includes mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you noticed your friend's new message saying they bought tickets but do not know whether it includes yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どなたの分を買ったか、お確かめいただけますか。重ねて購入する前に分かるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you check whose tickets they bought? It would be best to know before buying duplicates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に聞きます。人数だけでなく、今日使う分かと、この行先までの分かも一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人に購入人数・今日の分か・行先をまとめて確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my friend. Besides how many people, I will also check whether they are for today and for this destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your friend together about passenger number, today's use, and destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでは、返信を待ってから伺いましょう。まだこちらでは購入を進めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us wait for the reply. We have not started a purchase here yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返事が来ました。友人が買ったのは自分一人の分で、今日この駅へ行く分だそうです。私の分はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信で友人自身一人分だけ今日の当該行先まで買い、自分の分はないと分かったことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The reply came. My friend bought only their own ticket, for today to this station. There is none for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that the reply confirms your friend bought only their own ticket for today's journey to this station, not yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、こちらではご自身お一人の分について相談するということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: So here you would like to discuss just your own ticket, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、二人分ではなく私の一人分をお願いします。友人の分は買い足さず、この行先と今日の日付で内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人分でなく本人一人分に変更し、今日の日付と行先で内容を確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please make it for me alone, not two people. Do not add another for my friend; I want to check today's date and this destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Change the request from two people to yourself alone and say you want to check today's date and destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お一人分の条件と価格をこちらでご案内します。お連れの方の購入分と分けて、内容をご確認ください。それでは、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will explain the conditions and price for one person here. Check it separately from your companion's purchase. Please come this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知と、ご自分の控えをお持ちですね。どの点を確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a notice and your own record. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類を出すように通知が来ました。でも、この一覧には印があるので、もう提出したと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出を求める通知が来たが一覧の印から提出済みと思っていたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A notice came asking me to submit documents. But this list has a check mark, so I thought I had already submitted them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a notice requesting documents arrived, but the mark on your list made you think you had already submitted them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この印は、窓口の受付などで付けられた物ですか。それとも、ご自身で付けた物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was this mark made at a counter when the documents were received, or did you make it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が書類を用意した時に付けました。提出を確認した印ではなく、そろった物を忘れないための印です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 印は自分が準備した書類に付けたもので、受付や提出の確認ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I made it when I prepared the documents. It is not confirmation of submission; it was to remember which items I had assembled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you marked the documents when preparing them, not as confirmation of reception or submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 準備できたことと、実際に提出したことを分けて確かめましょう。郵送や窓口への持参について、覚えていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish having everything ready from actually submitting it. Do you remember anything about mailing them or taking them to a counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類を入れた封筒がまだ家にあります。送ったと思い込んでいましたが、この分は手元に残っていると担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒が家に残り、この分は送った確認が取れていないと担当へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The envelope containing them is still at home. I had assumed I sent it, but I will tell the staff this set remains with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the envelope remains at home and you will tell staff that sending this set has not been confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状況を伺って担当へおつなぎします。通知で示された期限や、まだ用意できていない物についてもご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that situation on and connect you to the staff. Do you also have questions about the stated deadline or things not yet prepared?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 期限の読み方を確認したいです。一つだけ別の所から届く書類を待っているので、未着の状態でどう相談するかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限の読み方と、別の所からの書類一つが未着の状態で相談する方法を尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to check how to read the deadline. I am waiting for one document from elsewhere, so also want to ask how to consult while it has not arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask about reading the deadline and consulting while one document from elsewhere has not arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未着の事情と期限について、担当へお伝えください。通知とご自分の一覧を、分けて見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the staff about the unarrived document and deadline. Could you show the notice separately from your own list?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。通知を先に示し、一覧の印は私が準備時に付けた物だと説明します。封筒が手元にあり、一つは未着だと伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知と自分の一覧を分け、印の意味・手元の封筒・未着書類を担当へ説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will show the notice first and explain that I added the list marks during preparation. I will consult explaining the envelope is still with me and one document has not arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the notice from your list and say you will explain the marks' meaning, the retained envelope, and unarrived document to the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へ引き継ぎます。印の意味と、提出を確認できていない点を分けてお話しください。それでは、こちらの相談窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass that on. Explain the meaning of the marks separately from the lack of confirmed submission. Please go to this consultation counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受付ですね。症状の欄で書きにくい所はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first registration. Are any parts of the symptoms field difficult to fill in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日から頭が痛く、熱っぽく感じます。体温計が家になかったので、発熱なしに丸を付けてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日からの頭痛と熱っぽさを述べ、体温計がなくても発熱なしと記入してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have had a headache and felt feverish since yesterday. There was no thermometer at home, so I am unsure whether I can circle 'no fever.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have had a headache and felt feverish since yesterday, and ask whether you may write no fever despite having no thermometer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 測っていないことと、測って熱がなかったことは分けて伝えましょう。今日も、まだ体温は測っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Distinguish not measuring from measuring and finding no fever. Have you still not taken your temperature today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、測っていません。熱がないと分かったわけではないので、未測定と書いて、熱っぽく感じることも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日も未測定で無熱と確認したのではないため、未測定と感覚を両方伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I have not. I have not established that there is no fever, so I want to write 'not measured' and also say I feel feverish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your temperature is still unmeasured today, not confirmed fever-free, and you want to state both the lack of measurement and how you feel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのように、分かる内容を伺います。熱っぽさと頭の痛みは、同じころから感じましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask about what you know in that way. Did the feverish feeling and headache begin at the same time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 熱っぽさは昨日の夜です。頭が痛くなったのは昨日の昼で、二つを一緒に昨日の夜と書くと違ってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 頭痛は昨日昼、熱っぽさは夜で、同じ開始時期にまとめないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The feverish feeling began last night. The headache started yesterday at midday, so writing last night for both would be incorrect.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the headache began yesterday at midday and the feverish feeling at night, rather than giving both the same start time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの時期を分けて記入しましょう。今の様子についても、伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us record each time separately. Is there anything you would like to tell us about how you are now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今も頭は痛みます。昨日より強いかはうまく比べられないので、強くなったと自分で決めずに説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今も頭痛があるが昨日との強さは比べにくく、悪化と決めず説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My head still hurts. I cannot compare well whether it is stronger than yesterday, so I want to explain without deciding myself that it worsened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you still have a headache but cannot easily compare its strength with yesterday, and want to explain without assuming deterioration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 比べにくい点もそのままお伝えください。今のお話を医師へ引き継ぎます。問診票は、伺った内容に沿って記入をお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also say plainly that it is hard to compare. I will pass this to the doctor. We will help complete the questionnaire according to what you told us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 頭痛は昨日昼から、熱っぽさは夜から、体温は未測定と分けます。診察でも、感じたことと測った事実を混ぜずに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 頭痛と熱っぽさの開始時期と未測定を分け、感覚と測定事実を区別して診察で伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separate the headache since yesterday at midday, feverish feeling since night, and unmeasured temperature. During the examination I will distinguish feelings from measured facts too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the start times of headache and feverishness from the unmeasured temperature, and say you will distinguish feelings from measured facts during the examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その経過を医師へ引き継ぎます。こちらで問診票を確認しますので、記入できた所までお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will pass that progression to the doctor. We will check your questionnaire here, so please show the parts you have filled in.
